data.summary_en: KEEL uses verifier evidence to turn successes into reusable skills and failures into corrective lessons, and to support/refute/replace/eliminate skill claims as new evidence arrives, improving continual agent learning; on SkillFlow, task success-rate rises 4.2–21.7 percentage points over no-knowledge baseline, versus 2.4–9.6 points for default SkillFlow.
